people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel

translations.web: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will set My throne in Elam, and destroy its king and officials,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: and I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence king and princes, saith Jehovah.
